lines.raw: The big idea.
lines.say: The big idea.

lines.raw: The Privacy Rule answers one question: **when may PHI be used or shared?**
lines.say: The Privacy Rule answers one question: when may P H I be used or shared?

lines.raw: The default answer is "only when the rule allows it, or when the patient gives written permission".
lines.say: The default answer is "only when the rule allows it, or when the patient gives written permission".

lines.raw: Luckily, the everyday work of healthcare is allowed without asking each time.
lines.say: Luckily, the everyday work of healthcare is allowed without asking each time.

lines.raw: The pharmacy counter in Kathmandu.
lines.say: The pharmacy counter in Kathmandu.

lines.raw: When you hand your prescription to a pharmacist, you expect them to read it, give you the medicine and record the sale.
lines.say: When you hand your prescription to a pharmacist, you expect them to read it, give you the medicine and record the sale.

lines.raw: You do not expect them to read it aloud to the queue, or sell it to a medicine company for advertising.
lines.say: You do not expect them to read it aloud to the queue, or sell it to a medicine company for advertising.

lines.raw: Using information for the job is fine.
lines.say: Using information for the job is fine.

lines.raw: Using it for anything else needs your permission.
lines.say: Using it for anything else needs your permission.

lines.raw: Allowed without asking: TPO.
lines.say: Allowed without asking: T P O.

lines.raw: Here is a quick table.
lines.say: Here is a quick table.

lines.raw: **Treatment**. Meaning: Giving and coordinating care. Emily's example: Dr. Patel sends Emily's strep test result to the pharmacy so it can fill amoxicillin.
lines.say: Treatment. Meaning: Giving and coordinating care. Emily's example: Doctor Patel sends Emily's strep test result to the pharmacy so it can fill amoxicillin.

lines.raw: **Payment**. Meaning: Billing, claims, eligibility checks, collecting money. Emily's example: Dr. Patel's clinic sends claim 23098908 to Emily's plan; the plan checks she is covered and pays $77.
lines.say: Payment. Meaning: Billing, claims, eligibility checks, collecting money. Emily's example: Doctor Patel's clinic sends claim 23098908 to Emily's plan; the plan checks she is covered and pays 77 dollars.

lines.raw: **Health care operations**. Meaning: Running the business: quality checks, audits, training, fraud detection, planning. Emily's example: The plan's analysts study how many members had strep throat this year.
lines.say: Health care operations. Meaning: Running the business: quality checks, audits, training, fraud detection, planning. Emily's example: The plan's analysts study how many members had strep throat this year.

lines.raw: Other allowed uses.
lines.say: Other allowed uses.

lines.raw: The rule also allows some sharing for public interest reasons without asking, such as reporting certain diseases to **public health** authorities, responding to a **court order**, and reporting **abuse**.
lines.say: The rule also allows some sharing for public interest reasons without asking, such as reporting certain diseases to public health authorities, responding to a court order, and reporting abuse.

lines.raw: Each has its own conditions.
lines.say: Each has its own conditions.

lines.raw: When written permission is needed.
lines.say: When written permission is needed.

lines.raw: For purposes outside the allowed list, the covered entity needs a signed **authorisation** from the patient.
lines.say: For purposes outside the allowed list, the covered entity needs a signed authorisation from the patient.

lines.raw: It must say what will be shared, with whom, for what purpose, and when the permission ends.
lines.say: It must say what will be shared, with whom, for what purpose, and when the permission ends.

lines.raw: The patient can cancel it later.
lines.say: The patient can cancel it later.

lines.raw: **Marketing**: a drug company wants Emily's name to send her advertisements.
lines.say: Marketing: a drug company wants Emily's name to send her advertisements.

lines.raw: **Selling PHI**: the plan wants to sell member data to another company.
lines.say: Selling P H I: the plan wants to sell member data to another company.

lines.raw: **Psychotherapy notes**: a therapist's private session notes have extra protection.
lines.say: Psychotherapy notes: a therapist's private session notes have extra protection.

lines.raw: **Most research** that uses identifiable data (unless an approved waiver is in place or the data is stripped of identifiers, covered in the De-identification lesson).
lines.say: Most research that uses identifiable data (unless an approved waiver is in place or the data is stripped of identifiers, covered in the De-identification lesson).

lines.raw: **Employer requests**: Emily's manager asks the plan why she was off sick.
lines.say: Employer requests: Emily's manager asks the plan why she was off sick.

lines.raw: Minimum necessary.
lines.say: Minimum necessary.

lines.raw: Even when a use is allowed, you should use, share or ask for **only the minimum PHI needed** for the job.
lines.say: Even when a use is allowed, you should use, share or ask for only the minimum P H I needed for the job.

lines.raw: This is the rule data people meet every day.
lines.say: This is the rule data people meet every day.

lines.raw: Minimum necessary.
lines.say: Minimum necessary.

lines.raw: Share only the fields, rows and people the task truly needs.
lines.say: Share only the fields, rows and people the task truly needs.

lines.raw: For example: Task: "count strep throat claims by month".
lines.say: For example: Task: "count strep throat claims by month".

lines.raw: Needed: diagnosis code and service month.
lines.say: Needed: diagnosis code and service month.

lines.raw: Not needed: names, member IDs, addresses or exact birth dates.
lines.say: Not needed: names, member I D's, addresses or exact birth dates.

lines.raw: Two ways to answer the same request.
lines.say: Two ways to answer the same request.

lines.raw: Monthly claim cost report. Too much: `SELECT *` from the claim table, all columns, all years. Minimum necessary: Only `service_month`, `claim_type`, `allowed_amt` for 2025.
lines.say: Monthly claim cost report. Too much: SELECT * from the claim table, all columns, all years. Minimum necessary: Only service_month, claim_type, allowed_amt for 2025.

lines.raw: Check one disputed claim. Too much: Send the whole member history. Minimum necessary: Send only claim 23098908 and its lines.
lines.say: Check one disputed claim. Too much: Send the whole member history. Minimum necessary: Send only claim 23098908 and its lines.

lines.raw: New analyst onboarding. Too much: Give access to every database. Minimum necessary: Give access only to the tables their project uses.
lines.say: New analyst onboarding. Too much: Give access to every database. Minimum necessary: Give access only to the tables their project uses.

lines.raw: Where minimum necessary does not apply.
lines.say: Where minimum necessary does not apply.

lines.raw: It does not apply when a doctor shares information with another provider **for treatment**, when the patient asks for their own records, when the patient has signed an authorisation, or when the law requires the disclosure.
lines.say: It does not apply when a doctor shares information with another provider for treatment, when the patient asks for their own records, when the patient has signed an authorisation, or when the law requires the disclosure.

lines.raw: Doctors should not have to guess what another doctor needs to treat safely.
lines.say: Doctors should not have to guess what another doctor needs to treat safely.

lines.raw: Patient rights.
lines.say: Patient rights.

lines.raw: The Privacy Rule also gives patients rights over their own information.
lines.say: The Privacy Rule also gives patients rights over their own information.

lines.raw: Covered entities must explain these in a **Notice of Privacy Practices**, the leaflet patients receive at their first visit or find on the insurer's website.
lines.say: Covered entities must explain these in a Notice of Privacy Practices, the leaflet patients receive at their first visit or find on the insurer's website.

lines.raw: Right of access.
lines.say: Right of access.

lines.raw: Patients can see and get a copy of their records, including claims and billing records.
lines.say: Patients can see and get a copy of their records, including claims and billing records.

lines.raw: The entity generally has **30 days** to respond (one 30-day extension is allowed) and may charge only a reasonable, cost-based fee.
lines.say: The entity generally has 30 days to respond (one 30-day extension is allowed) and may charge only a reasonable, cost-based fee.

lines.raw: Right to amendment.
lines.say: Right to amendment.

lines.raw: Patients can ask to correct information they think is wrong.
lines.say: Patients can ask to correct information they think is wrong.

lines.raw: The entity can refuse in some cases, but must answer in writing, generally within **60 days**.
lines.say: The entity can refuse in some cases, but must answer in writing, generally within 60 days.

lines.raw: Accounting of disclosures.
lines.say: Accounting of disclosures.

lines.raw: Patients can ask for a list of certain disclosures of their PHI (not the routine TPO ones).
lines.say: Patients can ask for a list of certain disclosures of their P H I (not the routine T P O ones).

lines.raw: Right to request restrictions.
lines.say: Right to request restrictions.

lines.raw: Patients can ask for limits on sharing.
lines.say: Patients can ask for limits on sharing.

lines.raw: If they pay for a service fully out of pocket, they can stop the provider telling their health plan about it.
lines.say: If they pay for a service fully out of pocket, they can stop the provider telling their health plan about it.

lines.raw: Confidential communications.
lines.say: Confidential communications.

lines.raw: Patients can ask to be contacted a certain way, for example at a different address or phone.
lines.say: Patients can ask to be contacted a certain way, for example at a different address or phone.

lines.raw: Right to complain.
lines.say: Right to complain.

lines.raw: Patients can complain to the covered entity or to HHS's Office for Civil Rights.
lines.say: Patients can complain to the covered entity or to HHS's Office for Civil Rights.
